name: Ọrụ n'Ụlọ Nkwakọba Ngwaahịa na Logistics
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị ndepụta mgbasa ozi ọrụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ịmata ọrụ ndị ahụ, ihe onye ọ bụla na-eme na asambodo ndị na-enyere gị aka inweta ọrụ, site n'ịkpọ aha opekata mpe ọrụ anọ na otu ezi asambodo ya na onye na-enye ya
Mgbe e nyere gị pick list nwere SKU na koodu ebe, ịchọta ebe ngwaahịa ọ bụla dị ma hazie ihe ị ga-ewere n'usoro ije, ebe a gụrụ koodu ebe ọ bụla nke ọma
Mgbe e nyere gị ngwaahịa omume e bugara na packing list ya, ịnabata ngwaahịa ahụ ma dee ụkọ ọ bụla, mfe ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mmebi ọ bụla, ebe ọnụọgụ na ndetu ọ bụla ziri ezi
Mgbe e nyere gị igbe na ibu ha, ịhazi pallet n'enweghị ihe egwu, ihe dị arọ n'ala ma n'ime oke ibu, na-agbaso iwu ọ bụla dị na ndepụta nlele pallet
Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ ma ọ bụ ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ịhọrọ ụzọ dị mma iji buli, bugharịa ma ọ bụ kọọ ya mgbe ị na-arụ ọrụ ngwa ngwa, na-enweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime ọnọdụ 5 ziri ezi

chapters.name: Isi 1: Otu ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa si arụ ọrụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ọrụ n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na asambodo ndị na-enyere aka
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mata ọrụ ndị bụ isi n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na otu asambodo nwere ike inyere gị aka inweta ọrụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ndepụta mgbasa ozi ọrụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata ọrụ ndị ahụ, ihe onye ọ bụla na-eme na asambodo ndị na-enyere gị aka inweta ọrụ, site n'ịkpọ aha opekata mpe ọrụ anọ na otu ezi asambodo ya na onye na-enye ya.
Ọrụ mmalite a na-ahụkarị: material handler ma ọ bụ warehouse associate (onye na-ebugharị ngwaahịa), picker na packer (ndị na-emejupụta ọda ndị ahịa), stocker ma ọ bụ order filler, shipping and receiving clerk (onye na-elele ngwaahịa na-abata na nke na-apụ), inventory clerk (onye na-agụ ngwaahịa ma na-edozi ndekọ) na onye na-anya forklift. Site n'ahụmịhe, ị nwere ike ịghọ onye ndu (lead), onye nlekọta (supervisor) ma ọ bụ onye nhazi inventory ma ọ bụ logistics.
Ọtụtụ ọrụ mmalite achọghị asambodo mahadum. Ndị mmadụ na-amụtakarị ya n'ọrụ, ọtụtụ mgbe n'ime otu ọnwa ma ọ bụ na-erughị, ma na-amụta iwu nchekwa dabere n'ụkpụrụ OSHA. Ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na-achọ ndị na-abịa n'oge, na-agụ ọnụ nke ọma ma na-arụ ọrụ n'enweghị ihe egwu.
Asambodo nwere ike ime ka ị pụta ìhè. Manufacturing Skill Standards Council (MSSC) na-enye Certified Logistics Associate (CLA) na Certified Logistics Technician (CLT); ị ga-ebu ụzọ gafee CLA tupu i were CLT. Klaasị OSHA Outreach nke awa 10 na-enye gị kaadị mmecha; ọ bụ nke afọ ofufo, OSHA kwukwara na ọ bụghị asambodo (certification). Ịnya forklift na-achọ mgbe niile ọzụzụ na nyocha nke onye were gị n'ọrụ n'onwe ya.
Ụgwọ ọrụ na ohere ọrụ dị iche iche dabere n'ebe. Lelee Occupational Outlook Handbook gọọmentị na bls.gov maka ụgwọ ọrụ na ọdịnihu ọrụ, na ezi mgbasa ozi ọrụ dị nso n'ebe ị nọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Logistics: ịhazi na ibugharị ngwaahịa site n'ebe e mere ha ruo n'ebe a chọrọ ha.
- Ebe nkesa ngwaahịa (Distribution center): nnukwu ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na-ezipu ngwaahịa n'ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ nye ndị ahịa.
- Asambodo (Credential): akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ kaadị na-egosi na i gafere ule ma ọ bụ mechaa ọzụzụ.
- MSSC: Manufacturing Skill Standards Council, otu ọgbakọ mba America na-enye asambodo CLA na CLT.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Hand laborers and material movers
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Material recording clerks
- MSSC: Certified Logistics Technician (CLT) and Certified Logistics Associate (CLA)
- OSHA Outreach Training Program (10-hour and 30-hour classes)
Nwaa ugbu a: Chọta mgbasa ozi ọrụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa atọ dị nso n'ebe ị nọ. Maka nke ọ bụla, dee aha ọrụ ahụ, oge ọrụ (shift), ihe ọrụ ahụ na-eme n'otu ahịrị, na asambodo ma ọ bụ nka ọ bụla ọ na-arịọ. Wee meghee ibe MSSC CLT ma dee onye na-enye CLA na CLT.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ aha ọrụ ndị bụ isi n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ihe nke ọ bụla na-eme, na asambodo ndị nwere ike inyere gị aka inweta ọrụ.

check.q: Kedu ọrụ na-elele ngwaahịa na-abata na nke na-apụ n'akwụkwọ ha?
check.why: Shipping and receiving clerks na-eso ngwaahịa na-abata na nke na-apụ ma na-elele ha.

check.q: Onye na-enye asambodo Certified Logistics Technician (CLT)?
check.why: CLT, na CLA na-ebu ya ụzọ, bụ asambodo MSSC.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Otu ngwaahịa si agagharị na koodu ebe
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Chọta ngwaahịa site na SKU ya na koodu ebe ọ dị, ma hazie ihe ị ga-ewere n'usoro ije.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị pick list nwere SKU na koodu ebe, ị ga-enwe ike ịchọta ebe ngwaahịa ọ bụla dị ma hazie ihe ị ga-ewere n'usoro ije, ebe a gụrụ koodu ebe ọ bụla nke ọma.
Ngwaahịa na-agagharị n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa n'otu usoro kwa ụbọchị. Nnabata (receiving): ngwaahịa na-abata, a na-elele ha. Ntinye n'ebe (putaway): a na-edebe ha n'ebe a kara aka. Nchekwa (storage). Iwepụta (picking): ndị ọrụ na-ewepụta ihe maka ọda. Nkwakọ (packing). Mbupụ (shipping): ọda na-apụ n'ụgbọ ala.
Ngwaahịa ọ bụla nwere SKU (stock keeping unit), koodu maka kpọmkwem ihe ahụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ uwe elu anụnụ anụnụ nke nha large. Ebe nchekwa ọ bụla nwere koodu ebe. Ọtụtụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na-eji zone, aisle (ụzọ n'etiti shelf), rack (ma ọ bụ bay) na level (ọkwa), ya mere A-12-03-B nwere ike ịpụta zone A, aisle 12, rack 3, level B. Ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa gị ga-akụziri gị usoro nke ya.
Ọtụtụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na-eji scanner. Ị na-scan ebe ahụ na ngwaahịa ahụ ka sistemụ kọmputa (warehouse management system) mara ihe bugharịrị. Ọ bụrụ na ihe dị n'ebe ahụ adabaghị na SKU, kwụsị ma gwa onye ndu gị; ewerela ihe yiri ya.
Iji chekwaa nzọụkwụ, wepụta ihe n'usoro ije: hazie ndepụta gị site na aisle, wee site na rack, ka i jee aisle ọ bụla naanị otu ugboro.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gụọ SKU na koodu ebe maka ahịrị ọ bụla.
- Kewaa koodu ebe ahụ n'akụkụ ya: zone, aisle, rack, level.
- Hazie ndepụta ahụ site na zone, wee aisle, wee rack.
- N'ebe ọ bụla, scan ma ọ bụ lelee na SKU dabara tupu i wepụta ya.
- Ọ bụrụ na ọ dabaghị ma ọ bụ ebe ahụ tọgbọ chakoo, kọọ ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- SKU: stock keeping unit: koodu maka otu kpọmkwem ngwaahịa.
- Koodu ebe (Location code): adreesị ebe nchekwa, dị ka zone, aisle, rack na level.
- Putaway: ibuga ngwaahịa a nabatara n'ebe nchekwa ha.
- Picking: iwepụta ihe site n'ebe nchekwa iji mejupụta ọda.
- Warehouse management system (WMS): sistemụ kọmputa na-eso ebe ngwaahịa ọ bụla dị.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Material recording clerks
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị omume. Hazie pick list a n'usoro ije (zone, aisle, rack, level): B-04-02-A, A-12-03-B, A-03-01-C, B-01-05-A, A-12-01-A. Wee dee ihe akụkụ ọ bụla nke A-12-03-B pụtara. Lelee: usoro ahụ na-amalite A-03-01-C, A-12-01-A, A-12-03-B.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgụ koodu ebe, ịchọta ngwaahịa site na SKU ya na ịhazi pick list n'usoro ije.

check.why: Stock keeping unit bụ koodu maka otu kpọmkwem ihe.

check.q: Ị gara n'otu ebe, ngwaahịa ahụ adabaghị na SKU dị na ndepụta gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Gafee ahịrị ahụ ma ghara ikwu ihe ọ bụla
Kwụsị ma kọọrọ onye ndu gị
check.why: A ga-akọ ihe adabaghị ka ọda ahụ na ndekọ ahụ dịrị n'ezi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ịnabata ngwaahịa e bugara na ịgụ ngwaahịa
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Lelee ngwaahịa e bugara n'akwụkwọ packing list ya ma dee nsogbu ọ bụla.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ngwaahịa omume e bugara na packing list ya, ị ga-enwe ike ịnabata ngwaahịa ahụ ma dee ụkọ ọ bụla, mfe ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mmebi ọ bụla, ebe ọnụọgụ na ndetu ọ bụla ziri ezi.
Mgbe ụgbọ ala rutere, ndị nnabata na-elele na ihe bịara bụ ihe e nyere ọda ya. Ị na-atụnyere ngwaahịa ahụ na packing list (na purchase order, ma ọ bụrụ na i nwere ya). Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala na-enyekwa bill of lading, akwụkwọ mbupụ ị na-abịanye aka na ya.
Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla. Lelee SKU, ọnụọgụ na ọnọdụ ya. Ọ bụrụ na igbe kụrụ akụ, mmiri mikpuru ya ma ọ bụ o meghere emeghe, see foto ma ebe ọrụ gị kwere, ma dee ya. Ọ bụrụ na ihe bịara erughị ihe e depụtara, ọ bụ ụkọ (shortage); ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị, ọ bụ mfe (overage). Dee nsogbu ọ bụla n'akwụkwọ ahụ tupu ị bịanye aka, dịka usoro ebe ọrụ gị si kwuo. Ịbịanye aka n'akwụkwọ nnabata na-enweghị ndetu nwere ike ịpụta na ị nabatara ihe niile dị mma.
Ịgụ ngwaahịa (inventory) na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ụzọ ahụ. Cycle count bụ ịgụ ebe ole na ole kwa ụbọchị kama ịgụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa niile otu mgbe. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ gị adabaghị na sistemụ, gụọ ọzọ, wee kọọ ya. N'ebe a, izi ezi dị mkpa karịa ọsọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Nweta packing list (na purchase order ma ọ bụrụ na i nwere ya).
- Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla: SKU ziri ezi, ọnụọgụ ziri ezi.
- Lelee ọnọdụ igbe ọ bụla.
- Dee ụkọ, mfe ma ọ bụ mmebi ọ bụla n'akwụkwọ ahụ.
- Gbasoo usoro ebe ọrụ gị tupu ị bịanye aka na bill of lading.
- Kọọrọ onye ndu gị nsogbu.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Packing list: ndepụta ihe dị n'ime ngwaahịa e zitere.
- Purchase order (PO): ọda onye zụrụ ihe na-egosi ihe ọ zụrụ na ole.
- Bill of lading (BOL): akwụkwọ mbupụ onye na-ebu ngwaahịa na-enye; ịbịanye aka na ya na-egosi na ị nataala ngwaahịa ahụ.
- Ụkọ (Shortage): ihe bịara erughị ihe akwụkwọ kwuru.
- Mfe (Overage): ihe bịara karịrị ihe akwụkwọ kwuru.
- Cycle count: ịgụ ebe ole na ole n'otu oge ka ndekọ dịrị n'ezi.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Material recording clerks
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị omume. Packing list kwuru: SKU 1001, igbe 12; SKU 1002, igbe 8; SKU 1003, igbe 20. Ị gụrụ 12 nke 1001, 6 nke 1002, na 21 nke 1003, otu igbe 1003 kụrụ akụ. Dee akụkọ nnabata: ahịrị ọ bụla, ihe a tụrụ anya, ihe bịara, na nsogbu ahụ. Azịza: 1002 nwere ụkọ 2; 1003 nwere mfe 1 na mmebi 1.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ilele ngwaahịa e bugara n'akwụkwọ packing list ya ma dee ụkọ, mfe na mmebi.

check.q: Packing list kwuru igbe 10, mana 8 bịara. Kedu aha nke a?
check.why: Ihe erughị ihe akwụkwọ depụtara bụ ụkọ.

check.q: Otu igbe n'ime ngwaahịa e bugara dere mmiri ma dọwaa. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Dee mmebi ahụ n'akwụkwọ tupu ị bịanye aka, dịka usoro ebe ọrụ gị si kwuo
Bịanye aka n'akwụkwọ ma ghara ikwu ihe ọ bụla
check.why: A ga-ede mmebi ka e wee nwee ike ịrịọ maka ya ma ghara ịta ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa ụta.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Ịrụ ọrụ n'enweghị ihe egwu na inweta ọrụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ibuli ihe n'enweghị ihe egwu na ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Họrọ ụzọ dị mma iji buli, bugharịa ma kọọ ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ ma ọ bụ ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ ụzọ dị mma iji buli, bugharịa ma ọ bụ kọọ ya mgbe ị na-arụ ọrụ ngwa ngwa, na-enweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime ọnọdụ 5 ziri ezi.
OSHA kpọrọ aha ihe egwu ndị bụ isi n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa: forklift na ụgbọ ndị ọzọ na-eji ike, ibuli ihe na mmerụ ahụ site n'ime otu ihe ugboro ugboro, ibugharị ngwaahịa, kemịkal, ịmịfu, ịsọ ngọngọ na ịda, na robot na conveyor. Mmerụ ahụ a na-ahụkarị bụ mgbaji akwara site n'ibuli ihe na forklift ịkụ mmadụ.
Buli n'amamihe. Bụ ụzọ chee banyere ibuli ahụ na ụzọ ị ga-agafe. Bịaruo ibu ahụ nso, gbagọọ ikpere gị, mee ka azụ gị kwụ ọtọ ma debe ibu ahụ nso n'ahụ gị, ma atụgharịla n'úkwù: jiri ụkwụ gị tụgharịa. Jiri ụgbọ aka (cart), hand truck ma ọ bụ pallet jack mgbe ị nwere ike. Maka ihe dị arọ ma ọ bụ ihe siri ike ijide, rịọ ka unu buli ya ọnụ (team lift).
N'akụkụ ngwaọrụ: nọrọ n'ụzọ ije, lee onye na-anya forklift anya, ma agala n'okpuru ndụdụ forklift e weliri elu. Debe aka gị n'ebe dị anya na conveyor na-agagharị. N'oge okpomọkụ, na-aṅụ mmiri mgbe niile, were ezumike gị ma gwa mmadụ ma ọ bụrụ na isi na-atụgharị gị ma ọ bụ ahụ adịghị gị.
Ọsọ dị mkpa, mana ejila ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ nwere ihe egwu. Kọọrọ onye ndu gị ihe egwu dị ka ihe wụfụrụ n'ala, rack mebiri emebi ma ọ bụ ụzọ mpụta e gbochiri ozugbo.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chee echiche: ọ dị arọ ole, ebee ka ọ na-aga, ụzọ ọ dị ọcha?
- Bịaruo nso, gbagọọ ikpere, azụ kwụ ọtọ.
- Jiri ụkwụ gị buli, ibu nso n'ahụ gị.
- Jiri ụkwụ gị tụgharịa; atụgharịla n'úkwù.
- Jiri cart ma ọ bụ pallet jack, ma ọ bụ rịọ team lift, maka ibu dị arọ.
- Kọọ ihe egwu ozugbo.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ergonomics: ime ka ọrụ dabara ahụ mmadụ iji gbochie mgbaji akwara na mmerụ ahụ.
- Pallet jack: ngwaọrụ a na-eji aka akwali ma ọ bụ nke na-eji ike, na-ebuli ma bugharịa pallet obere ebe.
- Team lift: mmadụ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa na-ebuli otu ihe dị arọ ma ọ bụ siri ike ijide ọnụ.
- Ọrịa okpomọkụ (Heat illness): ọrịa site n'ịrụ ọrụ n'okpomọkụ, dị ka heat exhaustion ma ọ bụ heat stroke.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA: Warehousing
- OSHA: Warehousing hazards and solutions
- OSHA: Heat exposure
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee omume n'ụlọ jiri igbe tọgbọ chakoo ma ọ bụ nke dị mfe. Buli ya site n'iji nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, ma kwuo nzọụkwụ ọ bụla n'olu dị elu. Wee dee ihe egwu atọ ị nwere ike ịhụ n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na ihe ị ga-eme maka nke ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ibuli ma bugharịa ihe n'enweghị ihe egwu ma kọọ ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa n'ụzọ ziri ezi.

check.q: Ị chọrọ ịtụgharị mgbe ị bu igbe. Kedu otu ị ga-esi mee ya?
options: Bụ ụzọ bulie ya karịa isi gị
check.why: Iji ụkwụ tụgharịa na-echebe azụ gị; ịtụgharị n'úkwù mgbe ị na-ebuli ihe na-ebute mmerụ ahụ.

check.q: Ị hụrụ forklift ka ọ na-abịa n'aisle gị. Gịnị kacha mma?
options: Banye n'okpuru ndụdụ e weliri elu
Nọrọ n'ụzọ ije ma lee onye na-anya ya anya
Fee aka ma gaa n'ihu n'ụzọ ya
check.why: Ụzọ ije na ile anya na-enyere onye na-anya aka ịhụ gị ma mee ka ị ghara ịnọ n'ụzọ ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịhazi pallet n'enweghị ihe egwu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Hazie pallet: ihe dị arọ n'ala, ọkwa hara nhata, ibu niile n'ime oke.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị igbe na ibu ha, ị ga-enwe ike ịhazi pallet n'enweghị ihe egwu, ihe dị arọ n'ala ma n'ime oke ibu, na-agbaso iwu ọ bụla dị na ndepụta nlele pallet.
Ezigbo pallet na-erute n'otu iberibe ma na-echebe ndị mmadụ. Bụ ụzọ lelee pallet n'onwe ya: enweghị osisi gbajiri agbaji ma ọ bụ ntu pụtara apụta.
Igbe dị arọ na-aga n'ala, nke dị mfe n'elu. Mee ọkwa hara nhata ma dị larịị. Debe igbe n'ime ọnụ pallet ahụ (ọ dịghị nke na-agafe ọnụ). Tụgharịa ọkwa ọ bụla nke abụọ ka igbe gafee ibe ha (a na-akpọ nke a interlocking); ọ na-enyere ihe ahụ aka ijikọ ọnụ. Nọrọ n'okpuru oke ịdị elu na oke ibu nke ebe ọrụ gị.
Gbakọọ ibu niile. Ọmụmaatụ (naanị omume): igbe 20 nke 25 lb ọ bụla bụ 500 lb, gbakwunye pallet dị ihe dị ka 40 lb bụ 540 lb. Lelee na ọ dị n'okpuru oke maka pallet, rack na ngwaọrụ ahụ.
Jiri stretch wrap kechie ibu ahụ, sie ike site n'ala ruo n'elu, ma kechie ya na pallet. Tinye akara (label) ka ha chee ihu n'èzí ebe a ga-scan ha. Tupu a bunye ụgbọ ala, a na-eme ka breeki trailer ahụ jide ma tinye ihe mgbochi n'ụkwụ ya (wheel chocks); a na-agbasa ibu ahụ nhata n'ime trailer.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Lelee pallet: enweghị osisi gbajiri agbaji ma ọ bụ ntu.
- Igbe kacha arọ n'ọkwa ala.
- Ọkwa hara nhata, n'ime ọnụ, interlocked.
- Gbakọọ ibu niile ma lelee oke ya.
- Kechie stretch wrap ka o sie ike, site n'ala ruo n'elu, gụnyere pallet.
- Akara chere ihu n'èzí.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Pallet: ihe ndabere dị larịị nke osisi ma ọ bụ plastik a na-atụkọta ngwaahịa n'elu ya ka e wee bugharịa ha ọnụ.
- Interlocking: ịtụgharị ọkwa igbe ọ bụla ka ọ gafee ọkwa dị n'okpuru ya.
- Overhang: igbe na-agafe ọnụ pallet.
- Stretch wrap: plastik dị gịrịgịrị a na-ekechi n'ibu iji jikọta ya ọnụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA: Warehousing hazards and solutions
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (trailer brakes and wheel chocks)
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị omume. I nwere igbe 8 nke 50 lb, igbe 12 nke 20 lb na igbe 6 nke 10 lb. See pallet ahụ site n'akụkụ: igbe ndị ga-aga n'ọkwa ọ bụla. Gbakọọ ibu niile ya na pallet nke 40 lb ma lelee na ọ dị n'okpuru oke 1,000 lb. Azịza: 400 + 240 + 60 + 40 = 740 lb.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhazi pallet n'enweghị ihe egwu, ihe dị arọ n'ala, ọkwa hara nhata na ibu niile n'ime oke.

check.q: Ebee ka igbe kacha arọ na-aga na pallet?
check.why: Ihe dị arọ n'ala na-eme ka ibu kwụsie ike ma na-echebe igbe ndị dị mfe.

check.q: Omume: igbe 30 nke 20 lb na pallet nke 40 lb. Ole bụ ibu niile?
check.why: 30 x 20 = 600 lb, gbakwunye pallet 40 lb = 640 lb.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Inweta ọrụ na ịrị elu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee atụmatụ inweta ọrụ nwere ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, ebumnuche asambodo na ahịrị résumé bụ eziokwu.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ndepụta mgbasa ozi ọrụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata ọrụ ndị ahụ, ihe onye ọ bụla na-eme na asambodo ndị na-enyere gị aka inweta ọrụ, site n'ịkpọ aha opekata mpe ọrụ anọ na otu ezi asambodo ya na onye na-enye ya. Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ ma ọ bụ ihe egwu n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ ụzọ dị mma iji buli, bugharịa ma ọ bụ kọọ ya mgbe ị na-arụ ọrụ ngwa ngwa, na-enweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime ọnọdụ 5 ziri ezi.
Ebe ị ga-achọ: weebụsaịtị ọrụ nke nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ ọrụ mbupụ, ebe mgbasa ozi ọrụ obodo, ụlọ ọrụ staffing na American Job Center dị nso n'ebe ị nọ, nke nwekwara ike inye aka ịkwụ ụgwọ ọzụzụ na asambodo n'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ. Ọtụtụ ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na-ewe ndị nwere ndekọ mpụ; jụọ job center ahụ maka ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na-enye ohere nke abụọ (second-chance employers).
Ihe ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ na-achọ: ịbịa n'oge, ịgụ ọnụ nke ọma, omume nchekwa na ọsọ kwụsiri ike. Ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa na-atụkarị rate gị, dị ka ihe ole i wepụtara kwa awa (picks per hour). Ruo ya site n'ịrụ ọrụ n'amamihe (usoro ije, ịscan nke ọma), ọ bụghị site n'ịhapụ nchekwa.
Mee ka résumé gị dabara ọrụ ahụ. Jiri okwu omume na ezi ọmụmaatụ: "Counted and checked deliveries against packing lists" ma ọ bụ "Completed warehouse safety and logistics training (Koach Learn), 2026". Ndị agha mbụ: ọrụ ngwaahịa (supply), motor pool na logistics dị mkpa, ya mere dee ha n'okwu nkịtị.
Hazie otu ị ga-esi too. Asambodo dị ka MSSC CLA, wee CLT, na ọzụzụ forklift nke onye were gị n'ọrụ nwere ike iduga gị n'ọrụ na-akwụ ụgwọ karịa dị ka onye ndu, inventory control ma ọ bụ logistics coordinator.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ ma ọ bụ mmemme atọ dị nso, gụnyere American Job Center gị.
- Họrọ ebumnuche asambodo (dịka ọmụmaatụ MSSC CLA) na ụbọchị ị chọrọ iru ya.
- Dee ahịrị résumé abụọ bụ eziokwu site n'ihe ọmụmụ a ma ọ bụ ọrụ gara aga.
- Mee omume azịza sekọnd 30: "Kedu otu ị si anọgide na-eme ihe n'ezi ma n'enweghị ihe egwu mgbe ọrụ na-aga ngwa ngwa?"
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Rate: ọrụ ole ị na-arụ n'oge a kara aka, dị ka ihe ole i wepụtara kwa awa.
- American Job Center: ọfịs ọha n'efu na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ịchọta ọrụ na ọzụzụ.
- Second-chance employer: azụmahịa na-ewe ndị nwere ndekọ mpụ n'ọrụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CareerOneStop: find an American Job Center near you
- MSSC: Certified Logistics Technician (CLT) and Certified Logistics Associate (CLA)
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Hand laborers and material movers
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee atụmatụ inweta ọrụ gị: ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ ma ọ bụ mmemme atọ dị nso, ebumnuche asambodo gị na ụbọchị ya, ahịrị résumé abụọ bụ eziokwu, na azịza sekọnd 30 gị maka "Kedu otu ị si anọgide na-eme ihe n'ezi ma n'enweghị ihe egwu mgbe ọrụ na-aga ngwa ngwa?" Gụpụta azịza ahụ n'olu dị elu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide atụmatụ inweta ọrụ n'ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, nwere ebumnuche asambodo na ahịrị résumé bụ eziokwu.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Akụkọ nnabata Otu ọnụọgụ ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ ụkọ, mfe ma ọ bụ mmebi adịghị ya. Ahịrị ọ bụla na-egosi ihe a tụrụ anya na ihe bịara, e dekwara nsogbu ọ bụla. O dekwara ihe a ga-eme tupu ịbịanye aka na bill of lading na onye a ga-agwa. Pick list n'usoro ije Ebe ụfọdụ adịghị n'usoro, ma ọ bụ a gụhiere otu koodu. E hazịrị ihe niile site na zone, aisle, rack na level, a gụkwara koodu ọ bụla nke ọma. Ọ na-akọwa ihe a ga-eme ma ngwaahịa adabaghị ma ọ bụ ebe tọgbọ chakoo. Atụmatụ pallet Igbe dị arọ n'elu, overhang, ma ọ bụ ibu niile ezighi ezi ma ọ bụ karịrị oke. Igbe dị arọ n'ala, ọkwa hara nhata e interlocked, ibu niile ziri ezi n'okpuru oke, e kechiri ya ma tinye akara. Ọ gbakwunyere nlele pallet na nzọụkwụ nchekwa trailer. Atụmatụ inweta ọrụ Enweghị ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, enweghị ebumnuche asambodo, ma ọ bụ ahịrị résumé na-ekwu ihe na-abụghị eziokwu. Ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ ma ọ bụ mmemme atọ, ezi asambodo ya na onye na-enye ya na ụbọchị, ahịrị résumé abụọ bụ eziokwu. O nwere azịza sekọnd 30 e mere omume ya banyere izi ezi na nchekwa. Ọrụ n'enweghị ihe egwu Atụmatụ ahụ na-atụ aro ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ nwere ihe egwu iji rute rate. Azịza sekọnd 30 na atụmatụ ahụ na-ebute nchekwa ụzọ, ya na ibuli ihe n'enweghị ihe egwu na ịkọ ihe egwu. Ọ kpọrọ aha otu ihe egwu site n'ibe OSHA warehousing na otu esi egbochi ya. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma lelee ọzọ.

check.q: Ị nọ n'azụ rate picks-per-hour gị. Kedu ụzọ ziri ezi isi rute ya?
options: Hapụ ịscan ka ị gaa ngwa ngwa
Wepụta n'usoro ije ma scan nke ọma
check.why: Ịrụ ọrụ n'amamihe na-echekwa oge; ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ nwere ihe egwu na-ebute mmerụ ahụ na mperi.

check.q: Kedu ahịrị résumé bụ eziokwu ma sie ike?
options: "Forklift certified" (na-enweghị nyocha onye were gị n'ọrụ)
"Counted and checked deliveries against packing lists"
check.why: Ọ na-eji okwu omume na ezi ọrụ, ọ dịghịkwa ihe ọ na-ekwu na i nwere nke i nweghị.
